demos.name: OBO Delegation Inspector LAB
demos.description: Seven steps of on-behalf-of delegation: the person's token and the agent's client-credentials token go into an RFC 8693 exchange, and one delegated token comes out — sub kept, act added, aud and scope narrowed. The downstream accepts the delegated token and refuses the person's own. Mock engine or your own PingOne tenant (Mock/Real toggle).
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7560). Mock: no tenant, no credentials. Real: PINGONE_* + OBO_LAB_* in ~/Development/.env (owner-set). Docker: HOST_PORT=7560 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root.
